Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]INVS IVNNOBC. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them, standards with pyramidal tops. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXE[RCIT]VS.
